description: Find which applicant-tracking system a company's careers page runs on. Greenhouse, Ashby, Lever and Workable all publish open job board APIs, and all of them are unusable unless you already know the company's board name. None publishes a directory of its customers, and none could, since no vendor knows about the others. Use this first when you have a company name rather than a careers URL.

company.description: Company name or board name, for example 'anthropic' or '1Password'. Case and punctuation do not matter.

name: find_company_board
title: Find a company's job board
